title: pvResourceTexture
body:
## pvResourceTexture

Typed texture resource (vtkTexture) whose image comes from a connected pipeline node producing image data (vtkImageData), for example a PNG series reader or a resampled field. Like pvResourceImageTexture it is referenced by texture inputs such as pvLogo's Texture port and produces no dataset of its own. Choose it when the texture must follow pipeline changes; use pvResourceImageTexture to load a file directly.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Input must be image data; meshes or tables are rejected by the native input domain.
- Exercised by examples/schemaxis/paraview-textures.json, where file- and pipeline-backed textures gave identical data (verification/2026-09-16-catalogue-expansion.json resourceChecks); other inputs are unverified.

Native constructor: `Texture`. Identity: `textures/Texture`. Role: `resource`. Output kinds: `["texture"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: image data (uniform rectilinear grids) (vtkImageData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkImageData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | A label recording which file the texture originally came from. The native property has no command, so ParaView stores the text without reading anything: the image is always taken from the Input connection. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "process-local typed native resource",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvResourceTexture",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
